title: Accounts
about: Link your Facebook and TikTok accounts. Your AI agents use them to answer messages and comments, and for your ad numbers.
help: One click opens Facebook (or TikTok) in a new tab. Log in, choose your Pages and accept: Pilotix does the rest and the account turns green. The keys stay on Pilotix’s server, never in a page.

here.title: Used in “{{name}}”
here.noPage: No Page: link a Facebook account.

scopeHereHint: Its Page and ad accounts work here at once.
scopeAllHint: Each boutique then picks its Page in one click. A Page answers for one boutique only.

meta.name: Facebook and Instagram
meta.what: Your Pages, their messages and comments, and your ad accounts.
meta.notReady: Soon: Pilotix is getting the Facebook link ready.

tiktok.what: Your TikTok ad accounts. Their numbers come to Ads soon.

waitingHelp: Finish in the {{name}} tab that opened: log in, choose your Pages and accept.

closed: The tab was closed before the end. Start again whenever you want.
